svg.text: Figure 1. Firing-rate distributions, population timing, and cue modulation
baseline: trial 0-5 s; full trial: 0-25 s
Population rasters with functional-class delta-rate traces
four equal-width cohorts; heatmap: unit z-rate; traces: Hz relative to each unit baseline
Cue modulation versus baseline and full-trial firing rate
one shared color scale aligned with all four cohort panels
Source: 1,346 units; 80 trial-averaged PSTHs. Curves are descriptive and do not establish cell identity or causality.
